H.building_notes:
Building H (ÜIA.DARYN H, Комфорт lite, handover 27.02.2027) is a U-shaped block on the SOUTH edge of DARYN, roughly in the middle of the cluster's east-west length. It sits south of the large flat-roofed building and the central park, south-east of M. Brochure p5 render, which is viewed from the north (Улы Дала in the foreground, E/F on the right = west), shows H right on the southern cluster boundary, with TARIH buildings beyond. The key plan is north-up (compass С at top). Sections 1 (12 floors, NW) and 2 (12 floors) form the north bar. A two-storey built-in/attached unit called 'ВП' (office 11, given as 'section 7' in the CSV) is the NE corner. Sections 3 and 4 (12 floors each) form the east column. A small corner joint sits SW of section 4. Section 5 (9 floors) closes the south side. The courtyard opens to the west, toward Аллея Bolashaq and the parking by M. Outer sides per the key plan and sheet labels:
- NORTH: 'Перспективная улица'. This contradicts the overview, which put Перспективная улица south of DARYN. The key plan and the sheet 3D render both put it on H's north side. It is an inner, tree-lined cluster street between H and the flat-roofed building / central park, with Улы Дала roughly 150-250 m further north behind that building and the green strip.
- EAST: 'Вид на перспективный проект'. In the renders this is a north-south driveway, with the kindergarten and B/K beyond.
- SOUTH: 'Вид на кластер ÜIA.TARIH'. A green buffer and the boundary road, with TARIH beyond.
- WEST: 'Аллея Bolashaq'. The pedestrian alley and parking, with M across it.
- Inner side: 'Вид на ваш двор', the closed courtyard with a pool and playground.
No ground-floor façade of H can be seen from Улы Дала or Айтматова. Айтматова is about 600 m or more to the west, beyond M, C, G and F. Every office has h 4.22 m (ВП: 4.2 m on floor 1, 3.3 m on floor 2) and type-1 window openings 2.06 m wide.
